freeze_scope: Local protocol/source commit before performance run; not external preregistration
scenario_source: Seven scenarios identical to frozen recency v1 generator, with new seeds; action_effect_shift adds +6 practice only when study executed and -4 work only when build executed after episode64. This is a negative control against a globally shared transient-offset assumption, not a change of recorded action definitions.
parameter_reason: Single approximately-fortnight calendar time scale and transient stationary variance equal to the common observation noise scale; explicit modelling heuristics, no outcome-based search
model: y_e = x_e^T b + z(ended_at_e) + epsilon_e. Fixed b Gaussian prior precision1; z stationary zero-mean OU, rho=2**(-elapsed_days/16), Q=(1-rho**2)*1. All covariance terms share sigma2 with inverse-gamma(alpha=2,beta=1). Static-transient cross covariance retained. Marginal predictive Student-t at as_of+one-day horizon.
knowledge_protocol: Only correction-valid episode labels recorded_at<=issue cutoff. Rebuild filter in ended_at order for every cutoff, including late labels at their physical event times. Forecast beyond final eligible outcome; never use offline smoothing or label arrival as physical time.
support: Keep all original history, exact portfolio, context-known/range and target-baseline gates. No forced history decay, no relaxed thresholds. A supported forecast is not certification of current-regime relevance.
comparison: All 64 scheduled opportunities per target/method. Abstentions remain in availability denominator, and have null scores. Scores pair exactly the same supported episode IDs. Report MAE, interval width/coverage/score and marginal Student-t NLPD; no density claim for unmodelled joint outcomes. Aggregate gain cannot override any failed cell.
no_adoption_without: All benchmark gates plus evidence outside the known synthetic family. Prototype remains excluded from production package; no real person, identified latent life state, causal effect, policy value, calibrated coverage, or SOTA claim.
limitations: Single common variance cannot separately adapt noise drift; OU is an unverified model for one additive offset, not evidence of physiological/psychological state or long-term skill dynamics. Long static component may be obsolete; raw support checks cannot establish absence of drift.
tuning: No parameter, seed, scenario, source or gate change after reading results. Changes require v2 and preservation of failures.
